world.topic: Make Snake as a web game played in the browser: the snake moves on a grid and is turned with the arrow keys, eating food makes it one cell longer and adds a point, and running into a wall or itself ends the game. It has a title screen, the score during play, and a game-over screen with the final score and a way to play again.
